purpose: Offline accounting mechanics using saved source terms; not historical strategy scoring or settlement certification
mechanics_assumptions: Each independent scenario starts with hypothetical holdings, not a strategy signal or actual investment.
Event terms are supplied to the mechanics scenario by the accounting instant. This assumption does not clear historical publication gaps.
Whole successor/child shares are modeled as delivered at the scenario instant. Actual delivery timing remains unverified.
Economic basis allocation uses relative component values at that session's close, not tax basis and not future prices.
No real-case cash availability or fractional payout is assumed. Those claims remain outstanding.
The Arconic child quote is unavailable locally. A separate explicitly synthetic quote checks arithmetic only after the missing-quote rejection is checked.
